summary: The web dependency license inventory accepts an installed LICENSE file with an exact recognized Apache-2.0 fingerprint when a package manifest has no license metadata; omitted packages use the same path only after the npm archive matches its frozen lock integrity.

schema.detail: The license inventory schema is unchanged; its generated source provenance now records the recognized LICENSE-file path.

rules.detail: Unknown, modified or absent license text still fails closed; explicit manifest metadata remains authoritative.

compatibility.detail: Enables build-only dependencies that ship a verified license file but omit package.json license fields. The first recognized text is Adobe's Apache-2.0 LICENSE from @react-aria/optimize-locales-plugin 2.1.0; no dependency is added by this change.

recovery.detail: Revert this change and regenerate the inventory with scripts/ci-fractal-web-licenses to require manifest-only metadata again.
